name: Event-Driven Architecture (Mediator Topology)
forces_resolved: Centralized orchestration and coordination of complex multi-step workflows
Visibility into step-by-step transaction lifecycle state
Better error compensation handling than pure fire-and-forget broker
forces_unresolved: Mediator acts as a potential performance bottleneck and single point of coordination
Lower throughput compared to decentralized broker topology
applicability_conditions: Multi-step e-commerce checkout, payment clearing, or insurance claims workflows
Complex business processes requiring compensation on failure
Workflows requiring audit trails of state transitions
anti_requisites: Ultra-low latency requirements (< 15ms) incompatible with orchestrator state hops
Simple linear non-branching event streams (prefer broker or pipeline)
